|game_text=Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting a freighter at a battleground system, adds 1 to attrition against opponent here and their starships here may not 'cloak.' Opponent loses no more than 3 Force to your Force drains at same system.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[BoShek, Brash Smuggler]]; it is the current text. Other errata versions: [[BoShek, Brash Smuggler (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image here is the Players Committee card image (errata mark E), which prints this text.
* '''Original''' ([[BoShek, Brash Smuggler]]): text as given in the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009): “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting a freighter at a battleground system, adds 1 to attrition against opponent and their starships here may not 'cloak.' Opponent loses no more than 3 Force to your Force drains at same system.”.<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[BoShek, Brash Smuggler (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) changed “While piloting” to “When piloting” and “opponent and” to “opponent here and”: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting a freighter at a battleground system, adds 1 to attrition against opponent here and their starships here may not 'cloak.' Opponent loses no more than 3 Force to your Force drains at same system.”.<ref name="cl-1261_65-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref>
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) went back to “While piloting” and kept “opponent here”: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting a freighter at a battleground system, adds 1 to attrition against opponent here and their starships here may not 'cloak.' Opponent loses no more than 3 Force to your Force drains at same system.”.<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee posted this text on its rules forum on 21 February 2012, as an addition to Appendix A of the Advanced Rulebook (“just a small tweak to align attrition modifier with design intent”)<ref name="pcforum-p688729">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=48201, now titled “Current Rulings Archive July 2010 - August 2012”), post by Aglets, 21 February 2012 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=48201&start=40#p688729 forum post])</ref>. That is earlier than the first archived copy of the card-list wording (PC-E1, 21 July 2012), whose own date is not known.
